annotations.title: Liquid movers (rising cards that actually sell)

description: Use this when the user wants cards that are both rising in price and easy to sell: recent gainers filtered to cards with at least 25 recorded sales a year and a raw price of at least $5, across all games and sports. Better than trending_cards for flipping or selling decisions. Do not use for a single named card.

game.description: Restrict to one game or sport; omit for all.

include_unknown_volume.description: Also include cards whose yearly sales count is not tracked (mostly Pokémon from the Scrydex source). Off by default so every result has a verifiable sales figure.

limit.description: How many cards to return, biggest 30-day gain first (1 to 50, default 15).

name: liquid_movers

id.description: Catalog card id. Pass to get_card_prices, grading_roi or get_price_history.

sales_per_year.description: Recorded sales in the last year; null only when include_unknown_volume is on and the source does not track volume.

url.description: Card page with the full price ladder and history

excluded_unstable.description: Candidates dropped because their own 40-day raw series did not hold together.

volume_verified.description: False when the list had to include cards whose yearly sales count is not tracked (Pokémon and other Scrydex-sourced games have no volume data).

title: Liquid movers (rising cards that actually sell)
